text: Twelve fifty rules out the titanium shell, so I would go with rubberised plastic.

speaker: ME
text: mm-hmm

text: Good. Deadline for the second prototype is Friday, please confirm.

text: Friday works if the curvature spec is frozen by Wednesday.

text: Did anyone reproduce the latency spike from last night's deploy?

speaker: B
text: I did, it only happens when the cache is cold after a restart.

speaker: C
text: Cold cache would explain the p99 but not the error rate we saw.

speaker: B
text: The errors are timeouts from the same cold path, I have the traces.

speaker: A
text: Can we pre-warm the cache during the rollout instead of after it?

speaker: C
text: Pre-warming doubles rollout time, I would rather add a readiness probe.

speaker: B
text: A readiness probe on cache hit ratio would work, I can write it today.

speaker: A
text: Great, then we hold further deploys until the probe ships.

speaker: C
text: Agreed, and I will add an alert on the p99 so we catch it earlier.
